cell_design: One clean cell; each family/severity has four single-target cells and one common-mode cell. Existing stress parameters and RSNA fusion are unchanged.
realization_coupling: One stable exam/family/severity realization. Reuse each stressed view between its single-target and common-mode parent. Common-mode shares the noise field. Every removal retains exactly the parent's surviving scores.
summaries: soft probability changes despite unchanged predictions
within-cell MSP versus score sensitivity, TV and prediction flips
inference: Descriptive development audit; no learned model, no threshold tuning, no formal generalization test or significance claim. Cell means do not reproduce training-sampler weights. Repeated views/cells are not independent patients.
decision: Assess whether repair and damage have meaningful patient-diverse support, how dependent it is on synthetic stress, and whether simple sensitivity already supplies a useful failure-ranking signal. No numerical pass threshold is claimed as validated. Method changes require a separate decision.
